question: Which of the following is NOT a source of protein?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lemon.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lemon **is **not a source **of protein as it is a** fruit** and **does not contain **significant amounts of **protein.**
 
• Protein is an **essential macronutrient** that is needed for **muscle growth and repair,** as well as** various metabolic functions** in the body.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fish** is a **good source of omega-3 fatty acids,** which are important fo**r brain health **and can **reduce inflammation** in the body.
 
• Fish is a source of **protein** and is often considered a** lean protein option** due to its low fat content.
 
• **Meat,** chicken, and pork, is also a** source of protein **and can provide essential amino acids for the body.
 
• Different types of meat contain varying amounts of** fat and protein**. For example, **chicken breast** is a lean protein option, while **bacon** is high in fat and may not be the healthiest protein choice.
 
• **Milk** is a** source of protein **and is often consumed as a post-workout recovery drink due to its high protein content.
 
• Milk also contains **calcium**, which is important for **bone health and muscle function.**
 
• It can be consumed in various forms, such as **cow's milk, almond milk, or soy milk.**
